overview.title: The landmark everyone photographs first
overview.p1: The stone lion sits in central Ifrane and has become the unofficial emblem of the town. It is not an ancient monument — it is a modern sculpture that works as orientation point and meeting place.
overview.p2: Use it as the start of a centre loop: avenues, flower beds, Source Vittel and a café. Ten to twenty minutes is enough unless you linger for photos.
overview.p3: Morning light is kinder; midday can be harsh on pale stone. Combine with the rest of the garden city rather than treating it as a half-day destination.

q4.question: Worth a special trip?
